representation: One Parquet file per worksheet; all populated cell values are stored in positional columns, with source_row preserving row positions.
notes: Formula cells are exported as the cached values exposed by pyxlsb.
Sheet formulas, cross-sheet links, named ranges, formatting, and macros are not preserved in Parquet.
Use the original XLSB when Excel behavior or formula dependencies are needed.
